summary: The first mismatch is now source-located in the ordinary TTY message boundary. The Escape is consumed by the More wait inside the poisontell update_topl() call, after encumber_msg() has produced the burden line. C captures skip before that more(), so it writes the attribute feedback after Escape; done_in_by() then calls pline("You die...") with WIN_STOP set and replaces the pending line immediately. JavaScript mirrors the pre-more snapshot but its death path unconditionally dismisses the pending feel-weaker line, consuming later input and delaying death. The independent equipment-change refusal after the 528th emitted screen remains separate.

source.branch: C update_topl captures skip before its more call. The poisontell call enters without WIN_STOP, waits for the burden line, and retains skip=false when Escape sets WIN_STOP, so it displays the attribute feedback. The following short You die message enters with WIN_STOP and reaches the death comparison; update_topl skips the prior-line dismissal, replaces toplines, clears WIN_STOP and redraws. JavaScript incorrectly dismisses the pending feedback on this death path.

The later emitted-screen-528 equipment-change refusal is independent of this message mismatch and remains a separate worn/monster-movement boundary.
